data.text: Welcome, Luke. I learned to fish here with my family, and I want this lake supporting our village for years to come. I wouldn’t claim we’ve already agreed on an arrangement, but I propose 10 tons each this month. That earns each of us $10,000 and leaves enough fish for the lake to refill. We can negotiate shares, but any extra for one person has to come from someone else’s agreed share—not from taking more than 50 tons total. Let’s share our catches afterward and check the plan together each month. Kate, does that sound fair to you?
